years.what_changed: TWO different Q5s were sold as 2025 models. Early 2025 (old generation, announced July 2024): advanced key and HomeLink mirror standard, remote start on the Q5 40, 19-inch wheels on the 45, new Convenience plus package (incl. panoramic sunroof) for Premium, and navigation + interior lighting plus standard on Premium Plus; the 55 TFSI e plug-in was still offered. From May 2025 (all-new third generation): 268 hp (no mild hybrid, no plug-in in the US), run-flat tires instead of a spare, 11.9 + 14.5-inch screens, Bang & Olufsen with 16 speakers, sliding rear seat, panoramic roof standard only on the Sportback. Check the listing/VIN to know which one you're looking at.

models.on_list_rule: Every Bronco Sport is a 2-row 4x4. On the list where a sunroof can be had and the interior is black or a two-tone that includes black (OK since Oct 19 2026): Big Bend, Free Wheeling, Outer Banks (Ebony/Roast) and 2023-24 Badlands (Premium Package Ebony/Roast leather with the sunroof). Not: Heritage (Navy Pier), Heritage Limited (Norias), Base (no sunroof), 2025+ Badlands (Dark Space Gray seats), and any Navy Pier / Platinum Blue interior.

years.what_changed: New Heritage (Big Bend-based, Oxford White roof/grille/wheels, Navy Pier plaid cloth) and Heritage Limited (Badlands-based, 2.0L, moonroof and B&O standard, Norias brown interior) editions. Black Diamond Off-Road Package (skid plates, A/T tires, graphics) added for Big Bend and Outer Banks (also Base in the first order guide). New paints Atlas Blue, Eruption Green, Robin's Egg Blue (Heritage), Peak Blue and Yellowstone (Heritage Limited); Velocity Blue and Bronze Smoke dropped. 8-inch SYNC 3 screen. Last year of the Base trim.

models.on_list_rule: Two-row version of the CX-90 (2025+). Every CX-70 is AWD and every one has a sunroof as standard except the 2026 PHEV SC / SC Plus (no sunroof offered). Turbo Preferred / Premium: regular power sunroof (Mazda sources disagree whether the 2025-26 Premium has the panoramic one); Premium Plus and up: panoramic. Not on the list: Turbo S Premium Plus (quilted Tan Nappa only) and 2026 PHEV SC / SC Plus. The 3.3 Turbo is a mild hybrid, which counts as gas ($35,500 cap); the PHEV gets the $40,500 cap. New-car prices are far above the caps, so only older/higher-mileage CPO cars will fit.

years.what_changed: All-new model (two-row CX-90): 3.3 Turbo (280 hp), 3.3 Turbo S (340 hp) and PHEV (323 hp, 26 mi EV range). Seven trims. Remote-folding rear seats, big under-floor cargo bin, Alexa built-in. MSRP $40,445-$57,450 + destination ($1,375 at launch Feb 2024; $1,455 from Apr 3 2024, when the 3.3 Turbo arrived in fall 2024; $1,530 from Jul 2 2025).

Panoramic roof standard on SX, SX-Prestige, X-Pro, X-Pro Prestige; optional on EX ($1,000 package) and X-Line ($1,500 package). First Sportage Hybrid (LX/EX/SX-Prestige) and, later in 2023, the Plug-in Hybrid (X-Line, X-Line Prestige; panoramic roof standard on both).
